WordPress LMS with Integrated Quiz Maker

Keep your learners motivated with the WordPress LMS plugin’s quiz integration.
This feature allows you to add quizzes directly into your lessons, creating an interactive and engaging learning experience. In case you’re testing knowledge, reinforcing key concepts, or providing practice opportunities, quizzes are a great way to track progress and keep students engaged.
With customizable question types, scoring options, and feedback tools, you can create quizzes that align perfectly with your course goals.

You will need to get the WordPress Quiz Maker and create various quizzes based on your lessons.

It’s the perfect tool to align quizzes with your course goals, making it a powerful addition to your WordPress learning management system.

sections.faq:
Is there a user guide or any documentation available?

Of course! Take a look at the User Manual to explore all the features the plugin offers. It includes descriptions of the options, usage instructions, detailed video tutorials, installation guides, and more.
If you have any questions or need support, feel free to contact our support team through the FREE support forum provided.

Is it possible to connect my courses with Quiz Maker?

Yes! The FoxLMS plugin includes Quiz Maker, so you can easily create different exams with a clear scoring system.

Does FoxLMS require any fees or take a percentage of my course earnings?

No, FoxLMS does not take any share of your course earnings.

Is the FoxLMS plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the FoxLMS plugin works perfectly on mobile devices. Its responsive design ensures a great user experience on smartphones and tablets, allowing learners to access courses and use the platform from any device.

Can I translate FoxLMS plugin?

Absolutely, you can! This WordPress lms plugin is fully translatable.
You can use the Loco Translate WordPress plugin, trusted by hundreds of our clients, to handle translations. For more details, feel free to check out the helpful article.
